from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0044.png").convert("RGB"))

# Let determine current pose after frame 44:
# Frame 42 pose: xc=0.213, yc=4.336, th=225
# Frame 43 action: turn_deg=90 -> th=315 deg, move_m=0.5 -> dx=-0.354, dy=0.354 -> xc=-0.141, yc=4.690

f, H = 256.0, 1.55

# Plant pot base:
pot_mask = (img[:, :, 0] > 140) & (img[:, :, 0] < 200) & (img[:, :, 1] > 60) & (img[:, :, 1] < 110) & (img[:, :, 2] < 70)
pts = np.argwhere(pot_mask)

max_v = pts[:, 0].max()
center_u = (min_u + max_u) / 2.0

Xw = xc + Xc * np.cos(th) + Zc * np.sin(th)

import cv2, numpy as np

img89 = cv2.imread("/work/observations/obs_0089.png")
mask = (img89[:,:,2] > 90) & (img89[:,:,2] < 160) & (img89[:,:,1] > 40) & (img89[:,:,1] < 80) & (img89[:,:,0] < 40)
ys, xs = np.where(mask[:, 150:260])
xs += 150
print(f"Chair 1 in obs 89: x=[{xs.min()}, {xs.max()}], width={xs.max()-xs.min()+1}, bottom_y={ys.max()}, center_x={xs.mean():.1f}")

# obs 88 width was 250 - 180 + 1 = 71
# obs 89 width is xs.max() - xs.min() + 1
w88 = 71.0
w89 = float(xs.max() - xs.min() + 1)
d89 = 0.5 / (w89 / w88 - 1)
d88 = d89 + 0.5
print(f"Parallax depth d88 = {d88:.4f} m, d89 = {d89:.4f} m")

# Pose at obs 89:
# obs 88 was at (-1.3848, 4.6642), moved 0.5 along 210 deg:
# X = -1.3848 - 0.2500 = -1.6348
# Y = 4.6642 - 0.4330 = 4.2312
theta_rad = np.deg2rad(210.0)
Xc89 = (xs.mean() - 255.5) / 256.0 * d89
X_w = -1.6348 + d89 * np.sin(theta_rad) + Xc89 * np.cos(theta_rad)
Y_w = 4.2312 + d89 * np.cos(theta_rad) - Xc89 * np.sin(theta_rad)
print(f"Chair 1 world position from parallax: X = {X_w:.4f}, Y = {Y_w:.4f}")
'", "description": "Triangulate Chair 1 from obs 88 and 89"}
